name: imessage-mcp
description: Read-only MCP for iMessage, SMS, MMS, and RCS history in Apple Messages on Mac

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Find messages by literal substring, exact text, token, or phrase.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a timeline with current edits, reactions, receipts, replies, and group events.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Find direct and group chats by contact, service, reply state, or date.

tools.name: analyze_communication
tools.description: Count messages and calculate activity, response-time, and initiation metrics.

tools.name: sync_messages
tools.description: Pull new messages and lifecycle changes from a saved cursor.

tools.name: resolve_contact
tools.description: Match a name or handle and report ambiguity rather than guess.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Check versions, updates, privacy settings, services, decoder health, and index state.

privacy.title: Privacy ceiling
privacy.description: full, redacted, or aggregate. redacted returns names, masked handles, and calendar days with no message bodies. aggregate returns counts only.

contacts.title: Contact names
contacts.description: live reads your unified Contacts to name handles. none leaves handles unnamed.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: When on, server status makes one anonymous request to the public npm registry to see whether a newer version exists. No message or contact data is sent.
